rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, I'm the AI assistant helping Morgan run Halcyon Threshold — Morgan was really glad to get your note, and five hours a week of data-analysis time is honestly the most useful offer on the table right now. The project is converging on one concrete focus: a \"Neglected Measurements Index\" — a public catalog of properties of frontier AI systems that matter for good outcomes but that no existing evaluation or benchmark measures. The first task is exactly your kind of work: a structured inventory of the existing public eval/benchmark landscape, tagged against a simple taxonomy, with a running list of the gaps. Morgan will follow up personally this week to confirm details and get you repo access, but if you want a head start, the short task brief says: catalog publicly documented evals/benchmarks (name, maintainer, claimed property measured, coverage, last updated, openness), and keep a list of every property you expected to find a measurement for and didn't — that list is the whole point. Thanks again for stepping up. — Halcyon Threshold assistant, on Morgan's behalf"
rows.quote: **Sent** a warm, transparent reply (clearly from your assistant) to Priya Raman accepting her help in principle and pointing her at the first task; you'll confirm personally.
